title: Easy Pinball - Simpler setup and table management for Virtual Pinball
author: alltheprivilege
selftext:
Free download: [https://github.com/moonsushistudio/easy-pinball](https://github.com/moonsushistudio/easy-pinball)

I recently delved into the world of Virtual Pinball tables.. there's a solid community of fans and seemingly some support from the manufacturers/designers of real pinball tables. They've recreated many of the best tables but of course there are a few messy copyright restrictions, and it's all open source free tools, so getting it all setup is not worth it for the semi-initiated user. 

I used Claude to create this one page app that helps centralize the available tools and provides easy links to the download locations to set up new tables. 

Enjoy!
